role: wave 9, domain 5 (lattice height/offset undercut by 10h-60h), R5-cost, defense
audit: Domain-5 fixes so far: fixed lattice shifts lat_m30 22h (B055 oauc2 -0.0105), f9 32h (A011 pcyuz -0.0139), fa 42h (A011 l10ch -0.0188), F7 12h (A021 a0xw2 -0.0261): all lose on 2025/strong and trade V6-family gains for zrl03/ah02 losses. Split lattice SB/SA (B085 txodc -0.024, alu16 -0.035; strong -0.18/-0.10) answers the clones (d9exx +0.063, dua2j +0.041) at a large field cost. Per-battle mixed lattice mix4 (B088 irh7d -0.0021 [-0.023,+0.019], zero bytes, zero turns) has the smallest measured general cost but had never been tested against the domain-5 threat itself (undercut clones). Chosen: mix4. Combination partner: B084 p0f13 (B only, threat +0.035 lo>0 in confirm 6aetq, zrl03 +0.142 / zchain4 +0.110), because mix4's known losses are exactly zrl03 (-0.036) and zchain4 (-0.076) (wfvlw), and p0f13 keeps phoenix_init's mov dx,[4A17h] that mix4 uses as its coin (K/SD delete it, so K is incompatible).

recommendation: Do not promote MP or mix4. The best domain-5 fix (mix4, mixed lattice) clearly helps its threat when the undercut is 10h (clone42 +0.19) and against 2-copy V6 crowds (+0.13), and with p0f13 it becomes non-negative against all four leaders (udjgk +0.105) and both clones (dabce +0.100). But the combination screens only +0.0021 on field S (below the +0.006 bar), with 2025 -0.021 and strong -0.031, and it is 0.016 below p0f13 alone (2025 -0.023, lo<0). The domain-5 threat is a probe (no archived team undercuts 52h by 10h-20h, B065), so its value does not pay for a likely plain-field cost. Keep p0f13 without the lattice coin for combinations; keep MP (scratch/B095/mix4_A.asm + MP_B.asm) documented as the domain-5 defense to use only if a 52h-undercutting crowd appears. A confirm with a 2025 effect target would be needed before any lattice edit is promoted.
